rationale: Group by business capability rather than by individual requirements. Keep Registration, capacity, expiry and FIFO in one transactional authority; deploy Event Management, Registration, Attendance & Certification and Reporting independently across Java and Python. Identity & Access, Billing and Notification remain explicit executable mocks. This demonstrates selective scaling and failure isolation without implementing seven production domains.
invariants: Registration alone controls occupied slots and payment-dependent confirmation.
Notification and Reporting are independent downstream consumers, never synchronous registration gates.
Services integrate through explicit contracts, not cross-service SQL or shared domain libraries.
Four real services and three mocks must remain distinguishable in implementation and evidence.
